title: The Hilbert matrix on analytic tent spaces
summary: We study for the first time the action of the Hilbert matrix $$\mathcal H=(c_{n,k})_{n,k\geq 0}, \quad c_{n,k}=\frac{1}{n+k+1}$$ on the analytic tent spaces $AT^q_p, 1 1,$ stand among the $AT_{p}^{q}$ and correspond to the case $p=q$. The multiplication of the Hilbert matrix with the column matrix with entries the Taylor coefficients of an $f(z)=\sum_{k\geq 0} a_k z^k $ analytic in $\mathbb D$ introduces the series $$ \mathcal H (f)(z)= \sum_{n=0}^{\infty}\left(\sum_{k=0}^{\infty} \frac{a_k}{n+k+1}\right)z^n\,, \quad z\in \mathbb D\,\, $$ known in the literature as Hilbert operator.
